main_text.p: Quando ubi competut[?] plura iura, variis tempori-bus praefer-tim, & variis de causis: uno repudiato al-terū superest ut hic, & l. 21.S.de seruit. urb: l.17.S.de aquaiplui[?]. I-mo non su-perest, l.75.S. coem: l.17.§.acquir.heredi.tur, supererit{4} vetus.
Si librarius{b} in transscribendis stipulationis{c} ver-bis errasset{d}: nihil nocere, quo minus & reus, & fideiussor teneatur.
Filiusfamilias neque{e} retinere, neque recupera-re, neque apisci possessionem rei peculiaris vi-detur{f}.
Non solent, quae abundant{g}, vitiare scripturas.
1. l.77. S.de acquiren.heredit. solue. Non superest, si repudiata ipsa sit hereditas causa non adiecta, vel si repudiatur unum ex quo aliud necessario dependet, v.qua notavi ad l.77.

{b} l.15.§.1.§. de usufr: l.15.§.5.§.de excusat.tut: l.7.§.5.§.de oper.libert. Horatius de arte 2. Et scriptor si peccat, idem librarius, usque. Quamuis est monitus, venia caret. Librarios Graeci καλλιγραφος[?]: notarios ταχυγραφος, ὁ ξυγραφως[?]. Hi notas, illi literas: ut tabularii rationum supputationem tractabant.
{c} instrumenti l.8.§.de stat: testamenti v. l.7.C.de testam: precum v. l.2.C.de errore aduocat: contrac[?]tus l.1.C. plus valere quod agitur.

{d} citra dolum & falsum, idque in sermone, veluti si scripserit relictum iure restitutionis pro institutionis: mulierem renunciasse Valeriano, pro Veleiano: Titium substitutum procuratorem, pro institutum. In his, notarius commissum errorem corrigere potest, cum talis emendatio neminem laesdat, addit Bartolus, Ei permissum indistionem[?] & diem omissum adiicere, nisi dies esset de substantia instrumenti, ut in hypotheca. Si diem permutauit, talem errorem corrigere non potest, nisi de errore testibus constet. Si instrumentum parti traditum est, requiritur sententia iudicis in errore mutando. Error probari potest authentico, testibus, & partium confessione v.hic Decium.
{e} i. filiofamilias interdicta ad retinendam, recuperandam, adipiscenda possessione non competit.

{f} nam interdicta dantur pro possessione: filius autem quicquid adprahendit, peculiari nomine, statim pater eius possidet l 4.§.de acquir.possess. & l.65.§.de verborum obligationib: l.32.§.6.supra de auro: adde l.81.supra eodem: & 2.cap.Vtile per inutile 36. de regulis, in sext: l.20.supra de usuris: l.34.supra de hereditibus instit: l.34. supra de manumiss.testam: l.17.Codice de testam: l.34. Cod. de donationib. August.4.de ciuitate 27. Solet enim à viris peritis dici, Superflua non nocent.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "competut" (the printed form may be competit); "aquaiplui" in note a; "indistionem" (letters uncertain); "contractus" (scan shows contracus or contrafus); the Greek words in note b are read with uncertainty and marked [?]. The first Greek word of note b and the closing Greek word are not certain. "Seaevola" is printed "Seaeuola"; the u is read as the consonant v. Left margin mark "a" has no matching mark visible in the text. The superscript "4" after "supererit" is read as a reference mark; the note numbered "1." below may correspond to it, but this is not certain. The "||" bracket marks around the citation headings are copied as printed. Italic citations in the commentary are not marked as italic, since the scan is not clear enough to tell. Possible printing errors left as printed: "superierit"/"supererit" reading in the first line, "neminem laesdat", "Solet enim".
